HomeFAQ.title: How long does international delivery take?
HomeFAQ.description: Depending on the destination, most parcels reach major cities within 3–7 business days.

HomeFAQ.title: Can I track my shipment online?
HomeFAQ.description: Yes, every shipment comes with a tracking ID that allows you to check real-time updates.

HomeFAQ.title: What items are restricted from shipping?
HomeFAQ.description: Hazardous materials, perishable food, illegal goods, and fragile items may not be accepted.

HomeFAQ.title: Do I need to pay customs duty or import taxes for international shipments?
HomeFAQ.description: Yes, customs duties and taxes vary by country. The recipient is usually responsible for paying them.

HomeFAQ.title: What documents are required for international courier services?
HomeFAQ.description: A commercial invoice, packing list, and in some cases additional permits may be needed depending on the destination country.
